entries.title: Mark 1:1
segments: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

entries.title: Mark 1:2
segments: Even as it is written in Isaiah the prophet, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, Who shall prepare thy way.

entries.title: Mark 1:3
segments: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make ye ready the way of the Lord, Make his paths straight;

entries.title: Mark 1:4
segments: John came, who baptized in the wilderness and preached the baptism of repentance unto remission of sins.

entries.title: Mark 1:5
segments: And there went out unto him all the country of Judaea, and all they of Jerusalem; And they were baptized of him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.

entries.title: Mark 1:6
segments: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and [had] a leathern girdle about his loins, and did eat locusts and wild honey.

entries.title: Mark 1:7
segments: And he preached, saying, There cometh after me he that is mightier than I, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.

entries.title: Mark 1:8
segments: I baptized you in water; But he shall baptize you in the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: Mark 1:9
segments: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in the Jordan.

entries.title: Mark 1:10
segments: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens rent asunder, and the Spirit as a dove descending upon him:

entries.title: Mark 1:11
segments: And a voice came out of the heavens, Thou art my beloved Son, in thee I am well pleased.

entries.title: Mark 1:12
segments: And straightway the Spirit driveth him forth into the wilderness.

entries.title: Mark 1:13
segments: And he was in the wilderness forty days tempted of Satan; And he was with the wild beasts; And the angels ministered unto him.

entries.title: Mark 1:14
segments: Now after John was delivered up, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of God,

entries.title: Mark 1:15
segments: and saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe in the gospel.

entries.title: Mark 1:16
segments: And passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew the brother of Simon casting a net in the sea; for they were fishers.

entries.title: Mark 1:17
segments: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.

entries.title: Mark 1:18
segments: And straightway they left the nets, and followed him.

entries.title: Mark 1:19
segments: And going on a little further, he saw James the [son] of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the boat mending the nets.

entries.title: Mark 1:20
segments: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

entries.title: Mark 1:21
segments: And they go into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

entries.title: Mark 1:22
segments: And they were astonished at his teaching: For he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

entries.title: Mark 1:23
segments: And straightway there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,

entries.title: Mark 1:24
segments: saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus thou Nazarene? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.

entries.title: Mark 1:25
segments: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.

entries.title: Mark 1:26
segments: And the unclean spirit, tearing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

entries.title: Mark 1:27
segments: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What is this? a new teaching! with authority he commandeth even the unclean spirits, and they obey him.

entries.title: Mark 1:28
segments: And the report of him went out straightway everywhere into all the region of Galilee round about.

entries.title: Mark 1:29
segments: And straightway, when they were come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

entries.title: Mark 1:30
segments: Now Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever; and straightway they tell him of her:

entries.title: Mark 1:31
segments: and he came and took her by the hand, and raised her up; and the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.

entries.title: Mark 1:32
segments: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were sick, and them that were possessed with demons.

entries.title: Mark 1:33
segments: And all the city was gathered together at the door.

entries.title: Mark 1:34
segments: And he healed many that were sick with divers diseases, and cast out many demons; and he suffered not the demons to speak, because they knew him.

entries.title: Mark 1:35
segments: And in the morning, a great while before day, he rose up and went out, and departed into a desert place, and there prayed.

entries.title: Mark 1:36
segments: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him;

entries.title: Mark 1:37
segments: and they found him, and say unto him, All are seeking thee.

entries.title: Mark 1:38
segments: And he saith unto them, Let us go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also; for to this end came I forth.

entries.title: Mark 1:39
segments: And he went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.

entries.title: Mark 1:40
segments: And there cometh to him a leper, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

entries.title: Mark 1:41
segments: And being moved with compassion, he stretched forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou made clean.

entries.title: Mark 1:42
segments: And straightway the leprosy departed from him, and he was made clean.

entries.title: Mark 1:43
segments: And he strictly charged him, and straightway sent him out,

entries.title: Mark 1:44
segments: and saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go show thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

entries.title: Mark 1:45
segments: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to spread abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
